# The ontology HL-Gauss seeds are here so they finish first if job b (name conditioning) starts later.
# Recipe v2 (gh_train_043_sweep_v2.slurm): plain batch 16, 50 epochs, registered window 0.8 (epochs 41-50), prep_v4,
# equal weighting; ++attention_query_chunk=512 (Aurora debug job 8966370: finite, 0.578 s/step, 10.2 GB peak at batch 16;
# unchunked, every batch above 1 exceeded the 64 GB tile). Fine-tune 1 = aurora_run_cell_043.sh chains the Kemmeren
# fine-tune (arm alone_kemmeren, init_from the stage-1 last.pt, 20 epochs, lr 3e-4, warmup 30, effective batch 8), which
# keeps this row's loss, seed, weighting, model.*, wandb.round, wandb.tags and attention_query_chunk.
# rid_prefix=a1026: run ids a1026_<cell> and a1026_<cell>_ft (fresh; nothing resumes an older run). Cell names carry _v2_
# so logs (slurm/output/aurora_grid/<cell>.log) and checkpoints (checkpoints_aurora_2026_10_24/<cell>/, the runner's
# root) never share a path with round aurora_2026_10_24/25 cells. wandb.stack=frameworks comes from the env script.
# Columns: node slot, tile, cell, fine-tune 0|1, row options + stage-1 overrides.
